results.prompt: Review effective authorization of this detail operation, including inherited routing behavior.
results.no_finding_rationale: The exported inheritedDetail wrapper at line 17 enters dispatchDetail. The route at line 8 has no public exemption, so line 14 evaluates the global guard and both controller guards. A missing identity is rejected before identity fields are accessed; a tenant mismatch or owner mismatch makes every(...) false and returns 403. Only a matching tenant and owner reaches the handler. Absent method-level metadata therefore correctly inherits effective protection and is not itself a defect.

results.prompt: Review effective authorization of this customer detail operation and its route metadata.

findings.issue: Public route metadata bypasses the tenant and owner protection required for customer details.
findings.trigger: Call exemptedDetail with an authenticated identity whose tenant differs from customer.tenant or whose id differs from customer.ownerId.
findings.evidence: Line 9 sets public: true. Line 14 runs globalGuards and controllerGuards only when route.public !== true. The exemption therefore skips the identity guard at line 4 and both tenant/owner guards at lines 5-6. Lines 15 and 18 then return the customer through the exported detail operation. Lines 1-3 state that customer details are private to their tenant and owner.
findings.impact: Within the supplied routing contract, a cross-tenant caller or non-owner receives status 200 and the private customer body. A direct call without identity also bypasses local checks, although reachability without authentication through the real host is not established.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove public: true from exemptedDetail so the existing global and controller guards are inherited. Retain the established tenant-and-owner requirement and verify denial cases before treating the operation as authorized.
findings.required_fix: Remove the public exemption from this private detail route and prove cross-tenant and wrong-owner denial through the enforcement boundary.
findings.test_gap: Denied and allowed operation cases are unobserved because tests are prohibited. Proposed proof: at the enforcement boundary, cover same-tenant owner allowed, same-tenant non-owner denied, cross-tenant owner-id collision denied, and absent identity denied; assert the unauthorized response contains no customer body.
